Single-shot neuroscience numerical procedure construction. Do not call tools, browse, read files or execute during generation. Return only JSON fields description and code, containing complete self-contained Python. Do not claim a score. One unchanged submission, no execution feedback or repairs. Under240 source lines including blanks; whole fit/predict or encode/decode workload180seconds, one numerical CPU thread, approximately4GB requested memory not enforced. Use deterministic seeds. Explicit prompt shared across the exact three requested Sol versions, reasoning effort high.

Implement fit_predict(train_x, train_y, test_x, train_groups)->numpy.ndarray. Shapes train_x=(136, 87),train_y=(136,),test_x=(71, 87); output=(71,). train_groups is a dictionary with group_ids (training mouse IDs) and cv_fold (predeclared mouse-stratified training CV folds); for train-only grouping/validation/weight construction, never biological predictors. Test groups/labels are scorer-only. Learn all fitted transforms from training data only. Return complete finite output in target units and follow mask/label rules below. Reference implementation receives the same training groups where needed. Allowed imports numpy,scipy,sklearn,math,collections,functools,itertools,statistics,gc. No pretrained weights, specialist packages, file/network/subprocess access or dynamic exec/eval.

Frozen task contract:
# K06: Mouse-disjoint optotagged PV/SST waveform inference

Prepared for review; not frozen or scored.

Source: Petersen et al., [CellExplorer: A framework for visualizing and characterizing single neurons](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2021.09.002), [ground truth contributors](https://cellexplorer.org/publicdata/ground-truth-data/), [ground truth tutorial](https://cellexplorer.org/tutorials/ground-truth-tutorial/), [repository](https://github.com/petersenpeter/CellExplorer). The source consolidated list contains430 entries across nested and non-molecular tags. The executed subset uses only AllenInstitute_ mouse IDs and independently optotagged PV/SST. It excludes all other labs, VIP, broad VGAT, pyramidal, axo-axonic and Juxta entries. This avoids overlapping targets and contributor/lab-vs-label confusion; it is not a claim that a Juxta label defines a molecular class.

The189,152byte d533101 example downloaded previously is not used because it belongs to a different contributor/classification context. The2,833,832byte groundTruth_cell_list.mat is reused. Sixteen public Allen session metric MATs are acquired, including207 cells from16 mice (PV92 across5 mice,SST115 across11). Exact Git revision, URL, bytes and SHA256 appear in source.json. Allen source data are used under [Allen Institute research/noncommercial terms](https://alleninstitute.org/legal/terms-of-use) with attribution; the exact accessed terms HTML remains local with a recorded hash. Preserve those terms and citation obligations. CellExplorer BSD3Clause is retained separately in UPSTREAM_CODE_LICENSE.txt and is not assumed to establish rights for every contributor's data. All raw source bytes remain local in ignored caches; no source-byte redistribution is proposed. Attribution: Josh Siegle and Allen Institute for the Allen Visual Coding optotagged resource; Peter C.Petersen and CellExplorer contributors for processing/curation.

For each included cell, source menu_name+menu_UID joins exactly to sessionName+UID; source mouse ID must match. The independent GT list tag must agree with one-based row membership in per-session groundTruthClassification.PV/SST. No label is inferred from waveform thresholds or putativeCellType. Every one of207 matches passes independent verification.

Predictors comprise six upstream waveform scalars (troughToPeak,troughtoPeakDerivative,ab_ratio,PT_ratio,waveform_duration,waveform_halfwidth) and81 filtered mean-waveform samples on uniform -0.5to+1.5ms grid. Width/duration scalars are ms; ratios dimensionless. Divide each source waveform by its maximum absolute source amplitude and interpolate; source coverage, nonzero amplitude and finite samples are checked per cell. NaN means a missing scalar. No genotype,IDs,coordinates,putative celltype,optotag modulation/latency/significance,response curves,firing/ACG/ISI metrics are predictors. Excluding temporal activity features limits leakage from optogenetic manipulation schedules.

Sorted mice are permuted separately within class using a continuing default_rng(20261031); first ceil(25%) from each class form test. All cells from each mouse stay together. Train136cells from11mice (PV45,SST91),test71cells from5mice (PV47,SST24). Actual source group IDs and rows stay in local metadata/manifests. Parent receives hashes and may review identifiers locally. Inner training three-fold mouse partitions are stratified at mouse level and class-covered.

Interface: `fit_predict(train_x,train_y,test_x,train_groups)`. Inputs136×87,136,71×87; return71 integer labels0PV,1SST. train_groups is a dict with group_ids (actual training mouse IDs) and cv_fold (same-length fixed three-fold mouse-stratified CV assignment vector). Use these only for train validation and weights; all test identifiers and labels remain hidden; never biological predictors. Train-only preprocessing. Primary class_balanced_mouse_accuracy is mean accuracy within each mouse, then mean mice within class, then mean two classes. This gives mouse-level rather than cell-count-dominated inference. Adapter score returns canonical full-set score plus mouse diagnostics; call once, not on arbitrary row subsets. Pooled balanced accuracy can be reported secondarily.

Fixed conventional reference: median imputation+standardization+RBF SVM with C=.1,1,10,100, or median-imputed500tree ExtraTrees(max_features=sqrt or1), selected by the primary metric in fixed three-fold stratified mouse CV; one thread,seed20261031. It is a strong conventional waveform classifier, not a verified neuroscience SOTA claim. No predictive reference or model has been run. No test-fitted transforms. The exact three models gpt-5.6-sol,gpt-6-sol,gpt-6.1-sol receive the same context at high effort,one no-tool generation each,<240lines,180seconds,one numerical CPU thread. Parent review/freeze/dispatch pending.

Independent verify.py checks source bytes, all source IDs and tags, exact supplied waveforms/scalars, mouse-disjoint outer and class-covered inner splits, and toy grouped scoring without predictive methods or real-slice scores. Important limits: five source PV mice; genetic class is mouse/Cre-line level and can correlate with acquisition cohort; region metadata incomplete and excluded; only two tagged classes in one resource; upstream filtered averages, not raw spike sorting. These limits constrain interpretation, not data accessibility or label independence.


Final fourth-argument contract: train_groups is a dict with group_ids (actual training mouse IDs) and cv_fold (same-length fixed three-fold mouse-stratified CV assignment vector). Use these only for train validation and weights; all test identifiers and labels remain hidden; never biological predictors.
